description: Provides the reactive stream primitives and operators used throughout Nevermore for observable state and event composition.

Observable.luau.description: Observables are like an [signal](/api/Signal), except they do not execute code until the observable is subscribed to. This follows the standard Rx API surface for an observable. Observables use a [Subscription](/api/Subscription) to emit values.

ObservableSubscriptionTable.luau.description: This allows the storage of subscriptions for keys, such that something can subscribe onto a key, and events can be invoked onto keys.

Rx.luau.description: An empty observable that completes immediately Public entry points include `identity`, `Rx.pipe`, `Rx.failed`, `Rx.from`, `connectToSourceIfNeeded`, `disconnectFromSource`, `getEventsCopy`, `Rx.reduce`.

RxSignal.luau.description: Rx Signal provides the class/model implementation used by the Rx package.
